additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434716-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PD 312555359011] Payment terminal connection issue CRM:02919000066
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I can see fault event "PaymentTerminalUnreachable_PZx" in the error flags, the possible causes are:
Possible causes for this are:
1.Network cable defect or not connected
2.Network switch defect
3.Power supply of payment terminal defect or not connected
4.IP-address of payment terminal wrong
possible solutions:
Check network configuration of payment-terminal:
Static IP-address: 10.20.17.50
Subnetmask: 255.255.255.0
Gateway: 10.20.17.2
DNS: 10.20.17.2
Ping terminal (IP: 10.20.17.50)
Request you to please check the wiring and the ethernet IP of the terminal.
